entries.basis: Exact 2025 live-action How to Train Your Dragon, not the 2010 animated film, its sequels, books or TV spin-offs. Slant’s selected dragon-visuals praise sits within a broadly critical review; Guardian and TheWrap passages criticize the remake’s visual/staging choices. Sentiment describes each passage, not converted star ratings or a claim of overall consensus. Original June 9/10 publication days verified, not premiere or later modifications.
